tally: 2026-08-08: 1,072 announcements captured (00:03–22:44 IST) on a Saturday tape, 282 material rows → 7 verified movers. **The largest order of the day carries no rupee figure at all, for the second day running**: **Bajel Projects wins two EPC transmission packages from Power Grid Corporation** — the 765 kV Raigarh (Tamnar)–Jamshedpur line Part II over 33 months, and the 400 kV LILO at Jamshedpur over 27 months — which the company classifies **'Ultra-Mega' and 'Mega' against its own published scale of Rs 400 cr and above, and Rs 300–400 cr**. That is a floor of roughly Rs 700 cr on our arithmetic, some **31.5% of its market cap**, and the baseline stored no amount for either. Below it the day divides between capital being raised and capital being returned: **Deccan Gold's board approved over Rs 137 cr of preferential capital in CCDs, shares and warrants** to fund its gold and critical-minerals expansion as Altyn Tor entered production, while **Advanced Enzyme approved a Rs 69.70 cr open-market buyback at up to Rs 500 a share** — 1.24% of its capital and 9.99% of standalone capital plus free reserves, the ceiling used almost exactly to the limit. **Anlon Healthcare executed two share swaps**, paying **Rs 116.52 cr for 32.52% of Apiqo Organics entirely in its own stock at Rs 258 a share**, with a second agreement for 43.33% of Bizotic Lifescience whose price sits on pages our cache never read. **Rajgor Castor Derivatives' Rs 23.92 cr rights issue is ~33% of its market cap**, the largest proportional call of the day, and the earliest possible stage — NSE's approval letter leaves price, ratio and record date all as '[●]'. **Refex Renewables bought its way out of an insolvency**, settling a **Rs 33.39 cr liability for Rs 16.51 cr** to have a Section 7 petition against Sherisha Solar LLP withdrawn, alongside the sale of Ishaan Solar for Rs 3.93 cr and the SunEdison trademarks for Rs 1.00 cr. Six of the baseline's eight movers did not survive: **Unifinz Capital's Rs 1,000 cr, Ceigall's Rs 100 cr and Brandman Retail's Rs 20 cr are all debt** — debentures and commercial paper — and Unifinz's own board minute records that its equity fundraise **was deferred and not discussed**; **Axis Solutions and Sattva Engineering had both already been published**, on 05-Aug and 07-Aug respectively. **Chemkart carried a marquee ★ 'allotted to Ambit' that is the English word 'ambit'** in "falls within the ambit of related party transactions" — the identical false positive to Goyal Salt three days ago. The quietest genuinely good news on the tape is **Paradeep Phosphates winning in the Supreme Court**, which dismissed the Department of Fertilizers' appeal and left standing a direction to release **Rs 53.50 cr of Nutrient Based Subsidy with interest** — small against its size, and final.
